notes.null_rates: false_gain_rate pools every round; after the first acceptance the incumbent's stored score is the max of noisy measurements (winner's curse), so a null candidate rarely beats it by delta. false_gain_rate_round0 compares against H_0's unselected measurement and should be close to nominal_rate_at_calibrated_delta, which is ~8% (not 2.3%) because the within-task bootstrap underestimates the null sd at k = 2 (see E10).
